body.objective: Determine whether the certified finite-harmonic exponential-polynomial tangent-cone theorem extends to a genuine Sobolev local linearization-stability statement, or identify the first functional-analytic obstruction.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal finite-harmonic structural theorem and its complete Smith/primary, zero-factor and generalized-mode ledgers by exact hashes. Choose explicit Sobolev spaces, gauge slice, fixed-charge bundle component and correction category on the compact product; prove mapping, closed-range, Fredholm and tame/nonlinear regularity properties for the gauge-fixed linearized Weyl-Maxwell operator and its quadratic source. Identify the adjoint cokernel and compare it exactly with the five stabilizer Taub covectors. Then prove a local momentum-map normal form or certify the first failed hypothesis, such as derivative loss, nonclosed range, generalized zero modes or an enlarged cokernel. State precisely which finite-harmonic sufficiency statements survive completion. Land independent analytic checks or computer-assisted bounds where used, a assumptions ledger, and an Arms-Marsden-Moncrief/Fischer-Marsden comparison.
body.current_gate: finite-harmonic to Sobolev linearization-stability promotion, or exact failed hypothesis
body.forbid: no density argument used as surjectivity; no finite-mode rank used as a closed-range theorem; no exponential-polynomial correction called Sobolev solvability; no unstated gauge slice or charge fibre; no global nonlinear existence, stability, causality, particle, positivity, scattering or quantum promotion
activates: a rigorous boundary between the finite atlas and continuum initial data
a stronger Paper 13 generality statement or exact no-go
body.resource_hint: BRIDGE RESERVE 2. This is an analytic promotion gate, not another harmonic enumeration. Pull after the structural sign theorem unless the active finite-harmonic freeze itself exposes the decisive failed hypothesis.
